title: Dysregulated CSF T-cell responses and their evolution after intravenous immunoglobulin in Guillain–Barré syndrome
title_zh: 血浆中调节失调的T细胞反应及吉兰-巴雷综合征静脉注射免疫球蛋白后的演变
abstract: Abstract Guillain–Barré syndrome (GBS) is an acute immune-mediated neuropathy that frequently results in long-term disability. The cellular mechanisms underlying GBS and the immunomodulatory effects of intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIg) remain incompletely understood. In this prospective observational cohort study, we performed single-cell RNA sequencing with paired T cell receptor (TCR) sequencing on peripheral blood and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) collected before and after IVIg treatment from treatment-naïve patients with GBS. Pre-treatment blood and CSF were obtained from nine and eight patients, respectively; post-treatment samples were available from six patients for blood and three patients for CSF. Previously published healthy control (HC) blood and CSF single-cell datasets were analyzed for comparison. We characterized immune cell composition, transcriptional states, TCR clonality, and clonal dynamics across peripheral and CSF compartments as well as following treatment. Individuals with GBS exhibited enrichment of T helper 1 (Th1)-polarized CD4+ T cells, activated and resident-memory CD8+ T cells, and macrophages in CSF relative to paired peripheral blood. This CSF-to-blood enrichment was greater than in healthy controls (HCs) for Th1 cells, activated effector-memory CD8+ T cells, and inflammatory macrophages, although the overall degree of T-cell clonal expansion was similar between groups. In both GBS and HCs, expanded CSF CD4+ clonotypes were predominantly Th1-polarized and largely absent from blood, whereas expanded CD8+ clonotypes showed greater overlap between compartments. Among clonotypes detected in both blood and CSF, CD4+ and CD8+ T cells exhibited more activated transcriptional states in the CSF, a shift that was particularly pronounced in GBS. Following IVIg treatment, peripheral blood showed minimal changes, whereas CSF T-cell populations exhibited more substantial alterations, including reductions in Th1-associated and activated effector-memory states, increases in T helper 2 (Th2) and regulatory T cell populations, and changes in the clonal repertoire. Expanded T cell clonotypes with sequence-based predicted specificity for pathogens associated with GBS were identified in six patients, and convergent clonotype groups were detected both within and across patients. Demyelinating GBS is characterized by compartmentalized enrichment and activation of pro-inflammatory T-cell populations within the CSF rather than an overall increase in T-cell clonal expansion. Exploratory longitudinal findings further suggest that CSF T-cell populations are altered following IVIg treatment. Integrated single-cell transcriptomic and TCR analyses provide insight into the early immune response in GBS and identify candidate cellular pathways for biomarker development and therapeutic investigation.
abstract_zh: 吉兰-巴雷综合征（GBS）是一种常导致长期残疾的急性免疫介导性神经病。GBS的细胞机制及静脉注射免疫球蛋白（IVIg）的免疫调节作用尚未完全阐明。在本前瞻性观察性队列研究中，我们在IVIg治疗前后从IVIg治疗未经的GBS患者的外周血和脑脊液（CSF）中获取了搭配T细胞受体（TCR）测序的单细胞RNA测序数据。治疗前，获取了9例外周血和8例CSF样本；治疗后，6例患者的外周血和3例患者的CSF样本可用。先前发表的健康对照（HC）外周血和CSF单细胞数据集用于比较。我们在外周和CSF亚 compartments以及治疗后，表征了免疫细胞组成、转录状态、TCR克隆性以及克隆动力学。GBS患者相对于配对的外周血，CSF中富集了Th1偏向的CD4+ T细胞、激活的和驻留记忆的CD8+ T细胞以及巨噬细胞。与健康对照（HC）相比，GBS患者CSF中Th1细胞、激活的效应记忆CD8+ T细胞和炎性巨噬细胞的CSF-血丰富程度更高，尽管T细胞克隆扩张的总体程度两组相似。在GBS和HC中，CSF中扩增的CD4+克隆型主要为Th1偏向，且基本不在血液中检测到，而扩增的CD8+克隆型在两个亚 compartment之间的重叠度更高。在同时检测到血液和CSF的克隆型中，CD4+和CD8+ T细胞在CSF中表现出更活跃的转录状态，这种转变在GBS中尤为明显。IVIg治疗后，外周血显示出最小变化，而CSF T细胞人群出现了更显著的改变，包括Th1相关和激活的效应记忆状态减少、T辅助2（Th2）和调节性T细胞人群增加，以及克隆谱的变化。通过序列预测特异性的病原体与GBS相关的六例患者检测到扩增T细胞克隆型，且在患者内部和跨患者中检测到收敛克隆型组。脱髓鞘GBS的特征是CSF中炎性T细胞人群的局限性富集和激活，而非整体T细胞克隆扩张的增加。探索性的纵向发现进一步提示，CSF T细胞人群在IVIg治疗后发生改变。整合单细胞转录组和TCR分析，深入阐释了GBS早期的免疫反应，并为生物标志物开发和治疗研究确定了候选细胞通路。
